notes.title: Unknown Pleasures: the best Steam games you might have missed
notes.notes:
Welcome back to Unknown Pleasures, our weekly digest of our favourite new games released on Steam over the past few days that we’ve not already covered in detail.

This week: roguelite flight sims, The Thing as survival-strategy game, tank racing and cowboy commandos. (more…)
